summary.tldr: Adds the Lieutenant Governor of New Brunswick to the offices that must be filled by someone who can speak and understand both official languages.
what_it_does: Adds the Lieutenant Governor of New Brunswick, and any other person appointed by the Governor in Council to carry on the province’s government, to the Language Skills Act.
Requires people appointed to that office to be able to speak and understand both English and French when they are appointed.
Makes coordinating changes if Bill S-220 also becomes law, so the two bills do not conflict.
who_it_affects: People appointed to carry on New Brunswick’s government
summary.background: The Language Skills Act already requires people appointed to certain offices to be able to speak and understand both official languages at the time of appointment.
